name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := InitStatesLength hi
  have hd := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hd hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  simp [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, updatedStates]
  refine updatedStatesComm ?_ ▸ updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength hu)
    (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  simp [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, hl]
  intro k hk' hk
  cases hd k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  apply (inner_self_eq_zero' (𝕜 := ℝ)).mp
  refine le_antisymm (le_of_not_gt fun hp => ?_) real_inner_self_nonneg'
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hn, hxφ⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤)
    (Filter.Tendsto.eventually_const_lt hp hc.continuousAt)
  have hcont := hd.continuous.mul hc
  apply (hg (fun y => φ y • f x)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const)).not_gt
  simp only [inner_smul_right']
  refine integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hcont
    (hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hk.mul_right) ?_
    (mul_ne_zero (hxφ.trans_ne one_ne_zero) hp.ne')
  intro y
  by_cases hy : φ y = 0
  · simp [hy]
  · exact mul_nonneg (hn (Set.mem_range_self y)).1 (hs (subset_tsupport φ hy)).le

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hAn (n : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ n A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j)
    (hAn 3) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A
    (hAn 3) (j, i)
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hB j) x t
  have hs := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hBt j)
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    hJd x i (c := 𝓕.c) t
  have hρ := LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
    hJd t (c := 𝓕.c) x
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x),
    fderiv_mul_const hρ, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hAn 2) _) _, time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub (hs.const_mul _) (hJt.const_mul _),
    fderiv_const_mul hs,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hBt j)]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq,
    fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hB j) t x,
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hAn 2),
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i),
    fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j),
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, mul_sub, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_comm 𝓕.ε₀ 𝓕.μ₀,
    div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul, mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let c := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  change ((mulLinearMap.comp (mulLinearMap.flip c)).compr₂
    (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF)) a b =
    (mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap c ∘ₗ timeOrderF)) a b
  refine LinearMap.congr_fun₂ (ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs' ↦
    ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs ↦ ?_) a b
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, mulLinearMap_apply,
    LinearMap.flip_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply]
  obtain ⟨l1, l2, split⟩ : ∃ l1 l2 : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp,
      ∀ (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp),
      (∀ x ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ x ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel x φ) →
      crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs) = l1 ++ l ++ l2 := by
    exact ⟨_, _, fun l h => (insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ φs' l φs h).trans
      (List.append_assoc _ _ _)⟩
  trans ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
    (ofCrAnListF l1 * c * ofCrAnListF l2))
  · apply congrArg ι
    simp (disch :=
      simp only [List.forall_mem_cons, crAnTimeOrderRel_refl, hφψ, hψφ, true_and]
      exact List.forall_mem_nil _) only [c, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF,
      ofList_singleton, List.singleton_append, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
      map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF,
      split]
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, smul_sub, smul_comm]
  have h0 := split [] (List.forall_mem_nil _)
  simp only [List.append_nil] at h0
  rw [map_smul, map_mul, map_mul,
    Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ),
    mul_assoc, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← h0, map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
  by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ φ)
  · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq]
    exact (Algebra.mul_smul_comm _ _ _).symm
  · simp only [c, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic (Ne.symm hq), zero_mul, smul_zero]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var => contradiction
  case sub d _ ih => grind
  case' app l r il ir =>
    rcases il rfl l.wf.2.1 with vl | ⟨_, hl⟩
    case' inl =>
      rcases ir rfl r.wf.2.1 with vr | ⟨_, hr⟩
      case' inl =>
        obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
  case' tapp d _ ih | let' d _ ih _ | inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih | case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, h⟩
  case' tapp.inl => obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
  case' case.inl =>
    obtain ⟨_, rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v
  all_goals first
  | exact .inl (by constructor; assumption)
  | cases lc; exact .inr ⟨_, by solve_by_elim (maxDepth := 7) only [*, Exists.intro, Red.abs, Red.appᵣ, Red.tabs,
    Red.let_body, Red.case, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h k
  induction h generalizing c
  case refl => exact ⟨_, k, .refl _⟩
  all_goals
    cases k
    exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor <;> assumption⟩
    try exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case par.par iha ihb _ _ ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨_, ha⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨_, hb⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par ha.1 hb.1, .par ha.2 hb.2⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  all_goals
    first
    | cases I_irreducible _ ‹_›
      exact ⟨_, ‹_›, .red_I _⟩
    | obtain ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ‹_›
      exact ⟨_, h, .red_K ..⟩
    | obtain ⟨_, _, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ‹_›
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx ‹_›) (.par hy ‹_›), .red_S ..⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  rw [HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation]
  refine ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ⟨?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rintro s t (h | h) <;> constructor <;> exact h.symm
  rintro s t (h | h) μ u ht
  case' choice => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choiceR => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR ht, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    refine (h.follow_fst ht).imp fun _ => And.imp ?_ ChoiceBisim.bisim
    first | exact id | exact Tr.choiceL

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_ℓ_add_one i⟩
  let Y (g : C) := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let D (g : C) := (Y g).ncard
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (s := D '' Set.univ)
    ⟨_, 0, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  have hb := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt)
  change 2 * sInf (D '' Set.univ) ≤ _ at hb
  rw [← hg] at hb
  have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb
  rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
    ← Nat.sub_add_comm (Nat.le_add_right_of_le h_i_add_steps), Nat.add_sub_add_right,
    ← Nat.sub_add_comm h_i_add_steps, Nat.add_sub_add_right, mul_assoc] at h
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt
    (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le ?_))
  refine (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 ?_).trans h
  let q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩ steps
    (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hc := Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => q p.1 p.2)
    (s := (Y g).toFinset ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))))
    (t := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x)) (by
      intro x hx
      refine ⟨(_, _), ?_,
        (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
      exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
  simpa only [D, hammingDist, Finset.card_product, Set.toFinset_card,
    Finset.card_univ, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_fin] using hc

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    simp only [fiberMap, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, zero_smul, zero_add,
      Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    simp only [P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp,
      Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←h, P₀, P₁]
  trans (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval y.val + r_chal * P₁.eval y.val
  · dsimp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i]
    rw [he, he, hd]
    ring
  · simp only [P_i_plus_1, intermediateEvaluationPoly, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁,
      evenRefinement, oddRefinement, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, mul_sum, ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  apply Nat.le_induction
  · intro u h
    have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) :=
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    rw [hu]
    apply hC_proximityGapAffineLines
    rw [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq]
    simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation u,
      Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at h
    assumption
  · intro n _ ih u h
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
    apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
    have hp := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e (by
      rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
      simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form u] at h
      assumption)
    refine lt_of_lt_of_le hp ?_
    apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
    intro r hr
    exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (MC := MC) ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ :=
    (Set.Finite.pi' (fun _ => Set.finite_Icc B T)).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
      (f := fun n (k : Fin 4) => u (n + k)) (by tauto)
  have h m : u (i + m) = u (j + m) := Nat.strong_induction_on m fun m ih => by
    by_cases hm : m < 4
    · exact congrFun heq ⟨m, hm⟩
    · apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      simp (disch := omega) only [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1,
        (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1, Nat.add_sub_assoc, ih]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  convert (h (n - i)).symm using 2 <;> omega

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one (Fintype.card_ne_zero), ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq ?_).mp <;>
    simp only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] <;> grind

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have step {a b} (hab : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    convert (hrelation a b).mp hab |>.2 i using 1
    symm
    apply sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub,
      sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => step h.1 i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_const,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d] at hs
  intro i
  apply (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩).pow_right (n := i.1) |>.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_add (step h.1 i) (step h.2 i)))
    ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩ using 1 <;> ring
